title: DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
body:
ROONA HAMARI JAAN HAI MATAM HAMARI SHAAN HAI SHEH KI AZA PEHCHAN HAI TA HASHR HUM DENGE SADA KARBOBALA KARBOBALA
DIL ME RAHE KARBO-BALA AJRE RISALAT HO ADA DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
1. AKBER KE GHAM SE HAI JAWA'N IS ANJUMAN KA KARWA'N HUM AAJ HAI JOH KAMRA'N ZEHRA KI HUMKO HAI DUA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
2. KARBAL KI AISI HAI ZAMEEN QAM AMBIYA KI HAI JABEEN ROOH E IBADAT HAI YAHI CHEHRE PE DEEN KE HAI LIKHA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
3. UN PER SITAM KYUN KER HAI YEH SARKAR KE DILBAR HAI YEH QURAN KE PAIKER HAI YEH
HAI DEEN KO INSE AASRAA DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
4. HAI ROOH KI YEH BANDAGI SHEH KI AZA HAI ZINDAGI
KARTE RAHINGE HAR GHADI MATAM ALI KE LAAL KA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
5. ZALIM NA KAR USPER JAFA NOOR E NAZAR HAI YEH MERA BINTE NABI KI THI SADA
PHIR BHI SITAM HAR EK HUWA DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
6. ABBAS KE PARCHAM TAALE DIL KO SUKOON MILTA RAHE AHLE AZA KE QAFELE JAATEY RAHINGE KARBALA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
7. DEEN E NABI KI ZINDAGI ASGHER KE JHOOLEY ME PAALI SAARE JAHAN KI ROUSHNI ALBER KE QHADMOU KI ZIYA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
8. SHABBER KA HAI JOH NAZNEEN AISA NAHI DULHA KAHI
ZAQMOU SE ROUSN HAI JABEEN PAMAAL HAI SUB DASTO PAA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
9. AOUN O MOHD KI WEGA KEHTI THI JANG E KARBALA YAAD AAYI HYDER KI ADA ABBAS KA WOH HOUSLA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
10. HAATOH PE SHEH KE BEZUBAN YUN HOUSLA LEKER JAWAN HASKER DIYA HAI IMTEHAN HAR SO SITAM ROTA RAHA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
11. ISLAM KI JOH AAN HAI SHABBIR KA AHSAAN HAI BAQI HAMARI SHAAN HAI KEHTE HAI KHUD YEH AMBIYA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
12. AHLE WAFA KI JAAN HAI IMAAN KI PEHCHAN HAI HAQ PER WOH INSAAN HAI JO GHAM MANAYE SHAH KA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
13. BINTE ALI KE LAAL KA LIKHTE RAHO NOUHA FIDA AUR DAM NIKAL JAYE MERA BAS YEH KHUDA SE HAI DUA
<<MINI>>
DIL ME RAHE KARBOBALA
<<DIVIDER>>
AZZ ALAMDAR FIDA
